reviews.snippet: This place was on my bucket list due to all the hype. I don’t think any BBQ place that can’t cook enough food to stay open more than 1 hour should be allowed to be rated in the top 100 restaurants. The only reason they run out of food in 2 hours is how inefficient the service is. If it was efficient they would run out of food within 1 hour. I tried to avoid downtown Austin every chance I get due to the traffic. I was already in downtown and thought I don’t get the opportunity very often to try this place. I waited in line about an hour. It was definitely not worth the wait. The line moved very slow and they need to be a lot more efficient at what they do. They only have one person taking orders, one cash register, and one preparing the food. The Brisket sandwich was very good at $18.50. The pulled pork was OK, the turkey was not very good and dry. The sausage was not good at all, and it was spongy. The beans were not good, The potato salad was average, and the coleslaw was horrible. Probably the worst coleslaw I’ve ever had in my life. I thought the brisket was way overpriced at $39 a pound. it is an old building that should’ve been renovated years ago. I won’t say it’s a dump, but I don’t understand why barbecue places have to look so rundown and trashy. The food is extremely expensive and they are sure not spending any of the profits on the restaurant itself. I don’t understand why the so-called wonderful barbecue restaurants only cook enough meat to last two or three hours knowing they run out every day. If you’ve been in business for 20 or 30 years and you know you’re going to run out in two or three hours cook more food! It’s just poor business. And at the expense of the customers who support you. This is just an example of selfish business owners. Any bubba can learn how to cook meat but they are clueless as to how to run a business. Wow we are doing great cause we sell out in a couple of hours. That’s because you only cook a few pounds. Wow look how long our line is we are doing great. No that’s because you are so inept at running a business. I can now check it off my list and I will never go back to this place. Trust me it’s not worth the wait. There are other great barbecue places that are open 8 to 10 hours a day and have plenty of food. Apparently Franklin’s hasn’t figured this out. It’s just a poorly run business. I will not be one of the stupid ones to fall for this again. We also tried one of their pies took one bite and threw it away. The desserts are horrible.

reviews.snippet: Wanted to go here, checked on-line, found directions and got an Uber.  Only to arrive and find they had a private party so they were closed.  No notice on line at Google.   So they sold out to a corporate man.  To make more money versus serve the simple customer.  So be it.  Won’t return.  Sleep in the bed you make.

response.snippet: Hi Dave. So sorry to disappoint you. Our hours online state that we are only open for lunch -- folks start lining up a bit before we open and we are usually closed by 3pm. If you popped by at night, and we were having a private party, that would not have interrupted our normal business hours. Have a look at our business hours and hopefully you can try again.

reviews.snippet:
Today, I take back what I said 3 years ago because they didn't give me the correct portion of meat.  When I inquired about it, they insisted that they gave me at least 5lbs, and their scale is calibrated frequently.  The reason why after I repacked my meat it didn't weigh up to 5lbs is because I repack the meat, and the weight is lost in the juice & fat in repacking.  I repacked my meat after they were completed cold!  Please see the pictures.  I am almost 0.25lb shy of being 5lbs.  The butcher's paper is their original wrapper, not too oily or wet, my cutting board is dry, and my packages in parchment paper are also dry.

A total disappointment of this place that I have loved in the past 6 years.

==3 years ago, I said==
I love this place. People are nice and their brisket is the best

Place was overcrowded and service was not very pleasant.

reviews.snippet:
They can easily avoid this long wait line by having 2 people cutting meat. But they choose not to.
The barbecue overall is too salty that covered the original taste of meat. Cold slaw was awful which tastes like mud.
I feel sorry for all the people like me wasting time and money here.
Atmosphere was ok though, I can see their effort decorating the interior.
